about_the_game:
Ale Abbey Official Soundtrack.

Immerse yourself in the hallowed halls and lively breweries of Ale Abbey!

Enjoy 16 carefully crafted tracks that capture the essence of monastic life, from the quiet chants of the abbey to the bustling energy of a thriving brewery. Let these melodies accompany you on your journey of brewing, building, and managing your monastery for over 65 minutes of immersive music!
